cues.en: I want to address all sides of the ideological spectrum for a moment and hope we can all agree on a few facts.
cues.zh: 我想先谈谈意识形态光谱上的各个阵营，希望大家能就几个事实达成共识。

cues.en: Over the last two hundred years, surely we can agree that coal and oil have taken the world from a patchwork of backward rural economies
cues.zh: 过去两百年里，我们想必都能认同，煤炭和石油让世界从由落后乡村经济体拼成的格局

cues.en: through the industrial revolution
cues.zh: 经历工业革命

cues.en: into the modern age.
cues.zh: 迈入现代时代。

cues.en: I used to work as a geologist on oil exploration rigs in the Mediterranean and the North Sea, and help find the fossil fuels that have given you and me all the comforts we now enjoy.
cues.zh: 我曾在地中海和北海的石油勘探钻井平台上做地质学家，参与寻找化石燃料——正是这些燃料给了你我如今享受的各种舒适。

cues.en: Like it or not, that is the economic reality.
cues.zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，这就是经济现实。

cues.en: But we also have to acknowledge the fact that burning these fuels has caused problems like pollution,
cues.zh: 但我们也必须承认，燃烧这些燃料带来了污染等问题，

cues.en: bad health, and above all raised the level of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere
cues.zh: 健康状况恶化，最重要的是，提高了大气中的二氧化碳含量

cues.en: to the point at which it's causing global warming.
cues.zh: 到了引发全球变暖的程度。

cues.en: Like it or not, that's the scientific reality.
cues.zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，这就是科学现实。

cues.en: We're led to believe that the two sides of this debate are those who say the only way to deal with anthropogenic climate change is to dismantle the capitalist system,
cues.zh: 有人让我们相信，这场争论的双方，一边说应对人为气候变化的唯一办法是瓦解资本主义制度，

cues.en: and those who want to pretend it's all a hoax.
cues.zh: 另一边则想假装这一切都是骗局。

cues.en: I think the majority of sensible people would like to deal with the problem and support the free market system.
cues.zh: 我认为大多数明事理的人愿意解决问题，并支持自由市场体系。

cues.en: Normally, I wouldn't tackle a subject like this, but I need to address the messages I get every time I make a video about science,
cues.zh: 通常我不会碰这种话题，但我需要回应每次我做科学类视频时收到的那些消息，

cues.en: suggesting that accepting science is an indication that I must be left wing,
cues.zh: 这些消息暗示，接受科学就表明我一定是左翼，

cues.en: as if all conservatives must be scientifically illiterate
cues.zh: 好像所有保守派都一定不懂科学

cues.en: or that science and capitalism are incompatible.
cues.zh: 或者说科学与资本主义不相容。

cues.en: So forgive me for spending a couple of videos on how climate science relates to the world of politics and economics.
cues.zh: 所以请原谅我用几期视频来谈气候科学如何与政治和经济世界相关联。

cues.en: I'll put that away. This whole video is my opinion.
cues.zh: 我先把这个收起来。整个视频都是我的个人观点。

cues.en: But it's going to be an opinion based on facts,
cues.zh: 但这会是一个基于事实的观点，

cues.en: and as always, my sources are cited in the video description.
cues.zh: 而且一如既往，我的资料来源会在视频简介中列出。

cues.en: I want to show why I think science, a healthy environment,
cues.zh: 我想说明为什么我认为科学、健康的环境，

cues.en: and free enterprise are all essential elements of our democratic way of life.
cues.zh: 以及自由企业，都是我们民主生活方式中必不可少的要素。

cues.en: And I want you to meet some of the entrepreneurs and inventors I've met as a science reporter
cues.zh: 我还想让你认识一些我作为科学记者遇到的企业家和发明家

cues.en: who are leading an energy revolution.
cues.zh: 他们正引领一场能源革命。

cues.en: But first, how did climate science suddenly become a political issue?
cues.zh: 但首先，气候科学怎么突然成了政治议题？

cues.en: After all, the link between carbon dioxide and temperature has been accepted by research scientists
cues.zh: 毕竟，二氧化碳和温度之间的联系，早已被科研人员接受

cues.en: since it was first discovered in 1896
cues.zh: 自1896年首次发现以来

cues.en: and confirmed in the nineteen forties.
cues.zh: 并在20世纪40年代得到证实。

cues.en: But the problem was largely confined to the scientific community
cues.zh: 但这个问题很大程度上局限于科学界

cues.en: until a visionary politician
cues.zh: 直到一位有远见的政治家

cues.en: who really understood the science
cues.zh: 真正理解这门科学

cues.en: spoke out on the world stage,
cues.zh: 在世界舞台上发声，

cues.en: and for the first time gave us this stark warning.
cues.zh: 并第一次给了我们这样严酷的警告。

cues.en: I spoke about the global threat
cues.zh: 我谈到了全球威胁

cues.en: of climate change.
cues.zh: 即气候变化。

cues.en: I set out the magnitude of the challenge we face.
cues.zh: 我阐明了我们面临的挑战有多严峻。

cues.en: Until recently,
cues.zh: 直到最近，

cues.en: we've always thought that whatever progress humanity makes,
cues.zh: 我们一直认为，无论人类取得什么进步，

cues.en: our planet would stay much the same.
cues.zh: 我们的星球都会大体保持原样。

cues.en: That may no longer be true.
cues.zh: 但这可能已不再成立。

cues.en: Next month, I should be going to the United Nations to set out our view on how the world should tackle climate change?
cues.zh: 下个月，我应该会去联合国，阐述我们对世界应如何应对气候变化的看法。

cues.en: We've proposed a global convention,
cues.zh: 我们已提议制定一项全球公约，

cues.en: a sort of good conduct guide to the environment for all the world's nations
cues.zh: 相当于给世界各国制定一份环境行为准则，

cues.en: on problems like the greenhouse effect.
cues.zh: 用来应对温室效应等问题。

cues.en: Britain has taken the lead internationally,
cues.zh: 英国已经在国际上带头，

cues.en: and we shall continue to do so.
cues.zh: 而且我们会继续这样做。

cues.en: Yes. It was a staunch conservative,
cues.zh: 没错。正是一位坚定的保守派，

cues.en: the iron lady herself,
cues.zh: 铁娘子本人，

cues.en: who gave a series speeches on global warming seventeen years before Al Gore turned it into a movie.
cues.zh: 在 Al Gore 把它拍成电影之前十七年，就发表了一系列关于全球变暖的演讲。

cues.en: To those who say Margaret Thatcher later rescinded her position,
cues.zh: 对那些说 Margaret Thatcher 后来收回立场的人，

cues.en: no she didn't. She has a degree in analytical chemistry,
cues.zh: 不，她没有。她拥有分析化学学位，

cues.en: so she was no dummy.
cues.zh: 所以她绝不是傻瓜。

cues.en: She never contradicted
cues.zh: 她从未否定

cues.en: the science. What she criticized was the way climate change was being used by a few extremists
cues.zh: 科学。她批评的是，气候变化被少数极端分子利用，

cues.en: as an excuse to attack the capitalist system.
cues.zh: 当作攻击资本主义制度的借口。

cues.en: The problem is that in The States,
cues.zh: 问题在于，在美国，

cues.en: powerful lobby groups have taken this to mean that anyone who accepts the science must therefore be a member of this nutty anti capitalist fringe group.
cues.zh: 强大的游说团体把这理解成：任何接受科学的人，必定就是那个疯狂反资本主义边缘团体的一员。

cues.en: That's why there's very little room in The USA for the voices of intelligent,
cues.zh: 这就是为什么在美国，明智、

cues.en: free thinking conservatives
cues.zh: 独立思考的保守派

cues.en: who do accept the science.
cues.zh: 且确实接受科学的人，几乎没有发声空间。

cues.en: If you want to carve out a career as a conservative pundit in The USA,
cues.zh: 如果你想在美国作为保守派评论员闯出一番事业，

cues.en: you have to repeat the politically correct talking points. The idea that the Arctic ice is disappearing is nonsense. The idea that the hockey stick graph is anything remotely resembling reality. That's why they call it climate change now and not global warming because the the Earth basically has not been warming for the last fifteen years.... Debunk all these Internet myths. I've done that in previous videos and so have many others. It's not hard to fact check, so there has to be a reason why Ben Shapiro is so willing to repeat these myths.
cues.zh: 你就必须重复那些政治正确的说辞。所谓北极冰正在消失的说法纯属胡说。所谓曲棍球杆曲线图哪怕有一丁点接近现实，这种说法也是胡扯。这就是为什么现在他们叫它“气候变化”而不是“全球变暖”，因为过去十五年地球基本上没有在变暖……揭穿所有这些网络谣言。我在之前的视频里已经做过，很多人也做过。事实核查并不难，所以 Ben Shapiro 这么愿意重复这些谣言，肯定是有原因的。

cues.en: Well, what Shapiro says next gives us a very revealing clue. All of which is to say, if you could come up with a solution
cues.zh: 那么，Shapiro 接下来所说的话给了我们一条非常说明问题的线索。这一切无非是说，如果你能想出一个解决方案，

cues.en: that did not hurt millions of people and plunge us back into the eighteen fifties,
cues.zh: 既不伤害数百万人，也不把我们拉回 1850 年代，

cues.en: then maybe we could talk about it. So it's not really the science Ben has a problem with. It's his fear that those who accept the link between c o two and global temperature
cues.zh: 那也许我们还可以谈谈。所以 Ben 真正有意见的并不是科学。他担心的是，那些接受 CO2 与全球气温之间存在联系的人

cues.en: have some sort of agenda and want to plunge us back to the 18.
cues.zh: 有某种议程，想把我们拉回 18 世纪。

cues.en: So he's only willing to accept the science if there's an acceptable solution.
cues.zh: 所以，只有存在一个可接受的解决方案时，他才愿意接受科学。

cues.en: And he's not alone. China,
cues.zh: 而且他不是唯一这么想的人。中国、

cues.en: India, US factories, cars,
cues.zh: 印度、美国的工厂、汽车、

cues.en: coal energy plants, and Hummers, not those Hummers, are generating only 3%
cues.zh: 燃煤电厂，还有 Hummers——不是那种 Hummers——只产生了 3%

cues.en: of the Earth's c o two. Again, I've already shown why this particular fallacy is wrong. It even made it onto my list of top 10 climate myths.
cues.zh: 地球的 CO2。再说一次，我已经说明过这个特定谬论为什么是错的。它甚至进了我十大气候迷思榜单。

cues.en: So that's not the point here.
cues.zh: 所以这不是重点。

cues.en: Far more interesting is why Penn Jillette feels the need to regurgitate myths like this.
cues.zh: 更有趣的是，Penn Jillette 为什么觉得有必要重复这类迷思。

cues.en: And in more pensive mood, he tells us.
cues.zh: 在更沉思的情绪下，他告诉我们。

cues.en: I am not sure that all the tenants of global warming are true. It seems pretty likely things are getting warmer. Seems pretty likely it was anthrogenic in some way.
cues.zh: 我不确定全球变暖的所有主张都是真的。事情很可能正在变暖。很可能在某种程度上是人为造成的。

cues.en: But then there comes this whole bill of goods that that it has to be done by conservation, it has to be done by government intervention, and it has to be all this done. And I was just saying that the whole package,
cues.zh: 但接着又来了这一整套说辞：必须靠环保节约，必须靠政府干预，必须这样那样。而我只是说，这一整套方案，

cues.en: I didn't know about. So as with Ben Shapiro, it's not really the science Penn has a problem with. He's only copying the politically correct talking points because he thinks the solution is more government control.
cues.zh: 我之前并不了解。所以和 Ben Shapiro 一样，Penn 真正有问题的并不是科学。他只是在照搬政治正确的论点，因为他认为解决方案就是更多政府控制。

cues.en: We'll see why they think that in part two. But in the rest of the world, conservatives have no problem accepting climate science and free market solutions.
cues.zh: 我们会在第二部分看到他们为什么这么想。但在世界其他地方，保守派完全能接受气候科学和自由市场解决方案。

cues.en: Even 10 of the world's biggest oil and gas companies accept it. They say they're gearing themselves up for what they see as a huge transition into renewable energy.
cues.zh: 连全球十大石油和天然气公司都接受它。他们说正在为向可再生能源的巨大转型做准备。

cues.en: So what are these conservatives seeing that a lot of American conservatives aren't?
cues.zh: 那么，这些保守派看到了什么，是很多美国保守派没看到的？

cues.en: I figured out long ago that humans work most efficient when we're free to do what we like, so let me be a voice that both extremes may not have heard before,
cues.zh: 我很久以前就发现，人类在能自由做自己喜欢的事时效率最高。所以，让我来发出两个极端或许都未曾听过的声音，

cues.en: belonging to the majority of people who don't think scientific facts and a healthy environment and free enterprise are incompatible.
cues.zh: 属于大多数人：他们不认为科学事实、健康环境和自由企业彼此不相容。

cues.en: Let me explain my thinking.
cues.zh: 让我解释一下我的想法。

cues.en: In my twenties, I began to formulate my idea of a government free society,
cues.zh: 二十多岁时，我开始构想我关于无政府社会的理念，

cues.en: which went like this.
cues.zh: 它是这样的。

cues.en: Imagine an island called Freedonia,
cues.zh: 想象一座叫 Freedonia 的岛，

cues.en: not owned by any country.
cues.zh: 不属于任何国家。

cues.en: People in search of freedom staked their claim and settled there, and agreed on just one rule.
cues.zh: 寻求自由的人在那里圈地定居，并且只约定了一条规则。

cues.en: Everyone has the freedom to do whatever he or she wants.
cues.zh: 每个人都有自由做任何他或她想做的事。

cues.en: Own guns, smoke dope, start a pig farm, anything.
cues.zh: 拥有枪支、抽大麻、开养猪场，什么都行。

cues.en: But of course, if someone starts a pig farm in his backyard,
cues.zh: 但当然，如果有人在自家后院开养猪场，

cues.en: that could pollute the water his neighbors use for drinking.
cues.zh: 那可能会污染邻居的饮用水。

cues.en: So the inhabitants of Fredonia had to come together again to qualify the rule.
cues.zh: 所以 Fredonia 的居民不得不再次聚在一起，给这条规则加限定。

cues.en: Everyone has the freedom to do whatever he or she wants,
cues.zh: 每个人都有自由做任何他或她想做的事，

cues.en: as long as it doesn't infringe on the freedom of others.
cues.zh: 只要不侵犯他人的自由。

cues.en: So I have the freedom to dump garbage in the ocean from my private beach if I want to.
cues.zh: 所以，如果我想，我有自由从我的私人海滩往海里倒垃圾。

cues.en: But if that garbage ends up on my neighbor's private beach or affects the number of fish caught by an enterprising fisherman,
cues.zh: 但如果那些垃圾漂到我邻居的私人海滩上，或影响一个有进取心的渔夫捕到的鱼数量，

cues.en: then I'm infringing on their freedoms,
cues.zh: 那我就侵犯了他们的自由，

cues.en: their property rights, and business rights.
cues.zh: 他们的财产权和经营权。

cues.en: This is such a basic principle of conservatism.
cues.zh: 这是保守主义如此基本的原则。

cues.en: Why is it so many conservatives caught up in the climate debate have forgotten it?
cues.zh: 为什么那么多卷入气候辩论的保守派忘了这一点？

cues.en: In the real world, when something impinges on people's freedom like this, society finds a way around it by setting targets to mitigate the problem,
cues.zh: 现实中，当某件事这样侵犯人们的自由时，社会会通过设定目标来缓解问题，找到出路，

cues.en: which encourages technological innovation
cues.zh: 这会鼓励技术创新

cues.en: and free market solutions.
cues.zh: 和自由市场解决方案。

cues.en: For example, when leaded gasoline infringed on a child's freedom to grow up without brain impairment,
cues.zh: 例如，当含铅汽油侵犯了儿童在不受脑损伤的情况下成长的权利时，

cues.en: the solution wasn't to ban cars or claim the researchers were faking their data. It was to phase out lead in gasoline and let the free market come up with an alternative,
cues.zh: 解决办法不是禁止汽车，也不是声称研究人员伪造数据。而是逐步淘汰汽油中的铅，让自由市场想出替代方案，

cues.en: which of course it did.
cues.zh: 而自由市场当然也做到了。

cues.en: The same thing happened with CFCs used in aerosol sprays that were breaking down the ozone layer.
cues.zh: 喷雾剂中使用的、会破坏臭氧层的CFCs也是如此。

cues.en: There was a rather feeble attempt to discredit scientists and claim it was all a hoax,
cues.zh: 也曾有人相当无力地试图抹黑科学家，声称这一切都是骗局，

cues.en: but society accepted the science and the free market came up with alternatives.
cues.zh: 但社会接受了科学，自由市场也拿出了替代方案。

cues.en: The point is that none of these innovations would have come about if we'd taken the attitude of Ben Shapiro that you only recognize a problem if someone first comes up with a solution.
cues.zh: 关键是，如果我们采取 Ben Shapiro 那种态度——只有别人先拿出解决方案，你才承认问题存在——这些创新都不会出现。

cues.en: Free enterprise doesn't work like that. It's the other way around. Science recognizes a problem, and then companies spend time and money coming up with a solution to fix it.
cues.zh: 自由企业制度不是这样运作的。恰恰相反。科学先识别问题，然后公司花时间和金钱想出解决办法来修复它。

cues.en: As I said, I'll tackle these fears about plunging us back to the eighteen fifties and greater government control in part two. But let's first look at a few other objections to the move towards CO2 reduction,
cues.zh: 正如我所说，我会在第二部分处理这些恐惧：让我们倒退回19世纪50年代，以及政府控制加强。但我们先看看对减少二氧化碳行动的其他几个反对意见，

cues.en: starting with the president of The United States,
cues.zh: 先从美国总统说起，

cues.en: who thinks the Chinese government invented global warming in order to trick The US into spending billions of dollars fixing a problem that doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 他认为中国政府发明了全球变暖，好骗美国花数十亿美元去解决一个不存在的问题。

cues.en: Meanwhile, he says, the Chinese themselves are spending nothing, giving them a competitive edge.
cues.zh: 他还说，与此同时，中国人自己一分钱不花，从而获得了竞争优势。

cues.en: The reality is the polar opposite.
cues.zh: 现实恰恰相反。

cues.en: First of all, clearly China didn't invent global warming. The link between CO2 and global temperature has been known about for a hundred and twenty years.
cues.zh: 首先，显然中国没有发明全球变暖。二氧化碳与全球气温之间的联系已经被人们知道120年了。

cues.en: And far from doing nothing, China is now leading this energy revolution.
cues.zh: 而且中国远非无所作为，现在正引领这场能源革命。

cues.en: For the last seven years, China has been the world's biggest producer and consumer
cues.zh: 过去七年，中国一直是全球最大的生产国和消费国，

cues.en: of renewable energy.
cues.zh: 即可再生能源方面。

cues.en: It's also the biggest investor in renewable energy research and manufacturing.
cues.zh: 它也是可再生能源研究和制造领域最大的投资者。

cues.en: China accounted for more new solar thermal and onshore wind power than The United States and Europe put together.
cues.zh: 中国新增的太阳能光热和陆上风电装机容量，超过美国和欧洲的总和。

cues.en: it produced twice as much renewable power as The United States.
cues.zh: 它的可再生能源发电量是美国的两倍。

cues.en: Extremists on the left and on the right who claim this move to clean energy is incompatible with capitalism
cues.zh: 左翼和右翼的极端分子声称，转向清洁能源与资本主义不相容

cues.en: should try telling that to Chinese entrepreneurs like Huang Ming,
cues.zh: 他们应该把这话说给黄鸣这样的中国企业家听，

cues.en: a solar energy billionaire.
cues.zh: 一位太阳能亿万富翁。

cues.en: He made his fortune manufacturing solar thermal tubes and built this huge research and manufacturing hub known as Solar Valley South Of Beijing.
cues.zh: 他靠制造太阳能光热管发家，并建起了这个庞大的研发制造中心，被称为北京南部的“太阳谷”。

cues.en: I spent three days here doing a profile on Huang Ming, and he was dismissive of the claims that capitalism is incompatible with good environmental practice.
cues.zh: 我在这里待了三天，做 Huang Ming 的专访，他对资本主义与良好环境实践不相容的说法嗤之以鼻。

cues.en: China is investing in renewable energy not to save the planet,
cues.zh: 中国投资可再生能源不是为了拯救地球，

cues.en: but because it makes economic sense.
cues.zh: 而是因为这在经济上说得通。

cues.en: Rising sea levels, a lack of water from glacial melt, increasing droughts and floods, and stronger typhoons. Regardless of whether POTUS thinks the Chinese made it all up, these things threaten China's future economic progress.
cues.zh: 海平面上升、冰川融水减少、干旱洪水增多、台风更强。不管美国总统是否认为这些都是中国人编造的，这些都在威胁中国未来的经济进步。

cues.en: And since the United States government has decided to opt out, China is more than happy to take the economic technological lead in the energy revolution we're already seeing.
cues.zh: 既然美国政府决定退出，中国非常乐意在我们已看到的能源革命中取得经济和技术领先。

cues.en: So ironically,
cues.zh: 所以讽刺的是，

cues.en: the expenditure of billions of dollars in renewable energy that president Trump was worried would cripple US factories
cues.zh: Trump 总统曾担心，在可再生能源上投入数十亿美元会拖垮美国工厂，

cues.en: is instead being spent in China,
cues.zh: 但这些钱反而花在了中国，

cues.en: where factories are humming.
cues.zh: 那里的工厂正开足马力。

cues.en: Five of the world's six top solar panel manufacturers
cues.zh: 全球六大太阳能电池板制造商中有五家

cues.en: and five of the largest wind turbine manufacturers
cues.zh: 以及五家最大的风力涡轮机制造商

cues.en: are now Chinese owned.
cues.zh: 现在都归中国所有。

cues.en: Their manufacturing drive
cues.zh: 它们的制造驱动力

cues.en: edge enables Chinese companies to sell solar panels, solar thermal tubes, batteries, electric bikes, and wind turbines all over the world, and dominate those markets.
cues.zh: 这一优势使中国企业能够把太阳能电池板、太阳能集热管、电池、电动自行车和风力涡轮机卖到全世界，并主导这些市场。

cues.en: According to a report by the Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis,
cues.zh: 根据能源经济与金融分析研究所的一份报告，

cues.en: as the global transition towards renewables gains pace and as battery storage and electric vehicle technologies pick up momentum,
cues.zh: 随着全球向可再生能源转型提速，以及电池储能和电动汽车技术加快发展，

cues.en: China is setting itself to dominate these sectors globally over the next few decades of this century.
cues.zh: 中国正准备在本世纪未来几十年主导这些全球产业。

cues.en: Critics say these industries are only growing because renewable energy is subsidized.
cues.zh: 批评者说，这些产业之所以增长，只是因为可再生能源得到补贴。

cues.en: Without the subsidies, it would be uncompetitive.
cues.zh: 没有补贴，它就没有竞争力。

cues.en: Well, of course it is subsidized.
cues.zh: 嗯，它当然有补贴。

cues.en: That's the basic principle of Fredonia.
cues.zh: 这就是 Fredonia 的基本原则。

cues.en: When an industry does harm to the environment, it should be discouraged,
cues.zh: 当一个产业对环境造成危害时，就应该受到抑制，

cues.en: and entrepreneurs should be encouraged to come up with solutions.
cues.zh: 而企业家应被鼓励提出解决方案。

cues.en: It's no good arguing that if renewable energy was profitable, it would have happened without subsidies.
cues.zh: 争辩说如果可再生能源有利可图，没有补贴也会发展起来，这没有用。

cues.en: The plain fact is it didn't,
cues.zh: 事实明摆着，它并没有，

cues.en: for the simple reason that for over a century, we already had a profitable source of energy, coal and oil.
cues.zh: 原因很简单：一个多世纪以来，我们已经有了一种有利可图的能源——煤炭和石油。

cues.en: If fossil fuels were producing electricity cheaper than solar panels and wind turbines,
cues.zh: 如果化石燃料发电比太阳能电池板和风力涡轮机更便宜，

cues.en: who in their right mind would want to switch to the latter as a source of energy or invest in it?
cues.zh: 哪个头脑正常的人会想转向后者作为能源，或投资它呢？

cues.en: But all you need to do to alter that balance is to take tax breaks away from the coal and oil industries and switch the money to the renewable power industry.
cues.zh: 但要改变这种平衡，你只需取消煤炭和石油行业的税收优惠，把这笔钱转给可再生能源产业。

cues.en: All it takes is to make solar and wind marginally cheaper in some areas,
cues.zh: 只需让太阳能和风能在某些地区稍微便宜一点，

cues.en: and all of a sudden you have a market.
cues.zh: 突然之间，你就有市场了。

cues.en: And once there's a market for a product, economies of scale kick in, and the product gets cheaper still.
cues.zh: 产品一旦有了市场，规模效应就会显现，产品也会变得更加便宜。

cues.en: And a market for a product means money is plowed into research, making the product more efficient.
cues.zh: 有了市场，资金就会源源不断地投入研发，从而提升产品效率。

cues.en: As it gets cheaper, the subsidies can be lowered and eventually removed altogether.
cues.zh: 随着成本降低，补贴可以逐渐减少，最终彻底取消。

cues.en: And that's exactly what's happened with wind and solar.
cues.zh: 而风能和太阳能正是走过了这样的历程。

cues.en: Over the last ten years, the cost of manufacturing solar panels and wind turbines has plunged,
cues.zh: 过去十年里，太阳能电池板和风力发电机的制造成本大幅暴跌，

cues.en: slashing the price of the electricity they produce.
cues.zh: 它们所产生的电价也随之骤降。

cues.en: At the same time, their efficiency has increased,
cues.zh: 与此同时，它们的发电效率不断提升，

cues.en: making them even more competitive.
cues.zh: 竞争力变得更强。

cues.en: As the price falls, many countries have reduced or eliminated subsidies altogether.
cues.zh: 随着价格下降，许多国家已经减少甚至完全取消了补贴。

cues.en: Electricity from renewables is now so cheap that even the coal museum in Virginia decided to install solar panels.
cues.zh: 如今可再生能源的电力如此便宜，就连弗吉尼亚州的煤炭博物馆都决定安装太阳能电池板。

cues.en: According to a 2017
cues.zh: 根据 2017 年

cues.en: report by the International Renewable Energy Agency,
cues.zh: 国际可再生能源署的一份报告，

cues.en: increasingly,
cues.zh: 这项技术正越来越呈现出

cues.en: the technology is competing head to head with conventional power sources
cues.zh: 与传统能源正面对决的态势，

cues.en: and doing so without financial
cues.zh: 而且完全不需要财政

cues.en: support.
cues.zh: 补贴支持。

cues.en: Objection number three comes from Alex Epstein, author of the book, The Moral Case for Fossil Fuels. This isn't exactly a news flash, but the sun doesn't shine all the time,
cues.zh: 第三个反对意见来自《化石燃料的道德理由》一书的作者 Alex Epstein。这倒不是什么新鲜事：太阳不会一直照耀，

cues.en: and the wind doesn't blow all the time. The only way for solar and wind to be truly useful would be if we could store them so that they would be available when we needed them. The windmills are wonderful, but, you know, when the wind doesn't blow, they really do cause problems. We
cues.zh: 风也不会一直吹。太阳能和风能要真正派上用场，唯一的办法就是能够储存它们，以便在需要时随取随用。风车虽好，但你知道，一旦没风，麻烦就大了。我们

cues.en: have no energy this week. Well, hopefully, the wind will start blowing pretty soon. It's
cues.zh: 这周就没电可用了。好吧，但愿风很快能吹起来。真

cues.en: hard to believe that this is the same nation that was once respected,
cues.zh: 让人难以相信，这曾经是一个受人尊敬、

cues.en: even revered,
cues.zh: 甚至备受景仰的国家，

cues.en: for having a can do attitude that built a railroad across a continent and put a man on the moon.
cues.zh: 曾凭着一股“凡事皆可为”的冲劲，建成了横贯大陆的铁路，还将人类送上了月球。

cues.en: When faced with a problem, past generations of Americans didn't give up,
cues.zh: 面对问题时，过去几代美国人从不轻言放弃，

cues.en: looked for solutions.
cues.zh: 而是去寻找解决之道。

cues.en: American know how and ingenuity was the envy of the world. These days, the attitude of, what can we do when the wind doesn't blow? Means it's mostly other countries that are rolling up their sleeves and finding solutions.
cues.zh: 美国的技术底蕴与创造力曾令世界艳羡。而如今这种“没风了我们能怎么办”的态度，意味着主要是其他国家正在卷起袖子，寻找解决方案。

cues.en: The intermittency problem doesn't just mean that sometimes you don't get any energy from wind and solar.
cues.zh: 间歇性问题并不只是意味着有时风能和太阳能发不出电，

cues.en: It also means you sometimes get too much.
cues.zh: 它还意味着有时电力会过剩。

cues.en: Wind energy is so plentiful in China that when I was in Beijing a few years ago, the country had to shut down a third of its wind turbines in the North because it couldn't use all the electricity they were producing.
cues.zh: 中国的风能非常充沛，几年前我在北京时，北方地区甚至不得不关停三分之一的风电机组，因为根本消纳不了发出来的全部电力。

cues.en: And I discovered that this is commonplace.
cues.zh: 后来我发现，这种情况其实屡见不鲜。

cues.en: Germany sometimes produces so much electricity from renewables
cues.zh: 德国有时通过可再生能源生产出过多的电力，

cues.en: that the price falls to below zero.
cues.zh: 导致电价跌至负数。

cues.en: In other words, plant operators have to pay consumers to use it.
cues.zh: 换句话说，发电厂甚至得倒贴钱给用户来用电。

cues.en: So what's needed is an efficient way of storing this excess. You can store oil in a tank.
cues.zh: 所以我们需要一种高效的方式来储存过剩的能源。石油可以储存在油罐里。

cues.en: Where do you store solar wind energy?
cues.zh: 但太阳能和风能要存在哪里呢？

cues.en: No such mass storage system exists.
cues.zh: 根本没有这种大规模存储系统。

cues.en: Which is like saying we need to get to the moon in a rocket, but we can't do it because no such rocket exists.
cues.zh: 这就像在说：我们需要坐火箭去月球，但我们做不到，因为这种火箭根本不存在。

cues.en: Or we have to build a railroad across America,
cues.zh: 或者说：我们得修建一条横跨美国的铁路，

cues.en: but it can't be done because there are mountains in the way. Come on, Americans. How far would The USA have got in the past with that attitude?
cues.zh: 但做不到，因为前面有山挡着。拜托，美国人，要是以前抱这种态度，美国能走多远？

cues.en: If mass storage systems don't exist, roll up your sleeves and invent them.
cues.zh: 如果大规模存储系统不存在，那就撸起袖子去发明它。

cues.en: Then, hey, presto, you get things that do exist,
cues.zh: 然后，瞧，这不就造出来了吗？

cues.en: like this huge battery now feeding the grid in South Australia.
cues.zh: 比如现在南澳大利亚给电网供电的这组巨型电池。

cues.en: Or in Wales where excess electricity is pumped up to a reservoir then runs back down through turbines when renewables don't perform.
cues.zh: 又或者在威尔士，电力过剩时水会被抽到水库中，在可再生能源发电不足时再放水驱动涡轮发电机。

cues.en: In Switzerland, compressed air is pumped into a sealed cave when there's too much electricity
cues.zh: 在瑞士，电力过剩时压缩空气会被泵入密封洞穴，

cues.en: and then released to drive turbines when there's not enough.
cues.zh: 电量不足时再释放出来驱动涡轮机。

cues.en: Energy can be stored in flywheels
cues.zh: 能量也可以储存在飞轮里，

cues.en: or as molten salt, which stays hot long enough to continue driving turbines for eight hours after the sun's gone down long enough to meet peak demand.
cues.zh: 或是储存在熔盐中，熔盐的高温足以在日落后继续驱动涡轮机运转八小时，足够应付用电高峰。

cues.en: Some excess energy is used to split water molecules to produce hydrogen,
cues.zh: 部分多余的电能用来电解水制氢，

cues.en: which can be turned back into energy through combustion.
cues.zh: 之后可以通过燃烧重新转化为能量。

cues.en: Of course, you can whine and moan that some of these systems have problems, but you know what to do. Roll up your sleeves and find solutions.
cues.zh: 当然，你大可以抱怨这些系统还有缺陷，但你知道该怎么做：撸起袖子，寻找解决方案。

cues.en: If you don't do it, your competitors will.
cues.zh: 如果你不做，你的竞争对手就会做。

cues.en: For example, lithium ion batteries are fine, but like everything else, they need to be made cheaper and more efficient.
cues.zh: 比如，锂电池是不错，但和其他东西一样，它需要变得更便宜、更高效。

cues.en: Last year, I went to a research institute in Taiwan to meet an engineer who did just that.
cues.zh: 去年，我去了一家台湾的研究所，见了一位正好做到了这一点的工程师。

cues.en: The battery his team developed is made of aluminum
cues.zh: 他的团队研发的电池是用铝制成的，

cues.en: lighter, cheaper, and longer lasting than lithium ion batteries,
cues.zh: 比锂电池更轻、更便宜，寿命也更长，

cues.en: and it can be recharged in just a few minutes.
cues.zh: 而且几分钟就能充满电。

cues.en: Another problem is that there's a shortage of places where water can be pumped into reservoirs.
cues.zh: 另一个问题是，适合建抽水蓄能水库的地方太少了。

cues.en: Okay. Find a solution to that too, like using heavy weights on rails instead of water.
cues.zh: 行，那就针对这个问题找办法，比如用轨道上的重力滑块来代替水。

cues.en: This system, by the way, was developed in The USA because some states are defying Washington's drive to go back to coal.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这个系统就是在源自美国研发的，因为有些州正在抵制华盛顿倒退回燃煤时代的做法。

cues.en: If you haven't got the message by now, you won't find solutions to a problem by pretending the problem doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 如果你到现在还没明白：假装问题不存在，是解决不了问题的。

cues.en: And you won't do it by whining that the solution doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 光抱怨没有现成的解决方案，也是行不通的。

cues.en: And you won't do it either by blaming capitalism
cues.zh: 把责任全推给资本主义，同样无济于事，

cues.en: and demanding that we go back to living in caves.
cues.zh: 更别提叫大家倒退回住山洞的原始生活了。

cues.en: Environmental problems get solved by recognizing a problem, setting common goals to eliminate it, and letting free enterprise and competition
cues.zh: 解决环境问题的途径是：正视问题，设定消除问题的共同目标，并通过自由企业与市场竞争，

cues.en: find the solution.
cues.zh: 去找出解决方案。

cues.en: In part two of this video, I'll look at how the Kyoto Protocol has fared. Did it bankrupt us, or did it actually succeed in reducing CO2 emissions?
cues.zh: 在本视频的第二部分，我会聊聊《京都议定书》的成效。它到底是拖垮了经济，还是真的成功减少了二氧化碳排放？

cues.en: I'll talk about my visit to a carbon trading room. How's carbon trading different to a carbon tax? The Australian government wants to bring the economy to its knees. Say no to the carbon tax. And what happened to Australia when it introduced,
cues.zh: 我会聊聊我参观碳交易大厅的见闻。碳交易和碳税有什么区别？“澳大利亚政府想搞垮经济。对碳税说不！”那么，澳大利亚在引入、

cues.en: and later dropped, the carbon tax.
cues.zh: 以及后来废除碳税时，到底发生了什么？

cues.en: And I'll have more on the exciting technological advances that are not only bringing us cleaner energy,
cues.zh: 我还会带来更多令人兴奋的技术进展，它们不仅为我们带来了更清洁的能源，

cues.en: but also more efficient energy use.
cues.zh: 还带来了更高的能源利用效率。

cues.en: Plus, how to take c o two out of the air and sell it for a profit.
cues.zh: 此外，还有如何从空气中抽取二氧化碳并卖掉获利。

cues.en: But before I go, listen to this clip from president Carter when he inaugurated a solar water heater on the roof of the White House in 1979.
cues.zh: 但在离开之前，先听听 1979 年 Carter 总统在白宫屋顶为太阳能热水器揭幕时的这段讲话。

cues.en: A generation from now, this solar heater
cues.zh: 从现在起过上一代人的时间，这台太阳能热水器

cues.en: can either be a curiosity,
cues.zh: 要么会成为一件猎奇玩物，

cues.en: a museum piece,
cues.zh: 一件博物馆展品，

cues.en: an example of a road
cues.zh: 一条未被选择的

cues.en: not taken,
cues.zh: 道路的写照，

cues.en: or it can be just a small part of one of the greatest
cues.zh: 要么它可以成为美国人民有史以来

cues.en: and most exciting adventures
cues.zh: 最伟大、最激动人心的

cues.en: ever undertaken by the American people. If America had embarked on that journey in 1979
cues.zh: 探索征程中微小的一部分。如果美国在 1979 年就踏上了这段征程，

cues.en: instead of 1997,
cues.zh: 而不是在 1997 年，

cues.en: which is when the rest of the world started that journey after the Kyoto Protocol,
cues.zh: 也就是世界其他地区在《京都议定书》之后起步的节点，

cues.en: we'd be twenty years ahead of where we are now.
cues.zh: 我们现在就能领先二十年。

cues.en: We would have had competitive solar and wind power by 1999,
cues.zh: 我们在 1999 年就能拥有具竞争力的太阳能和风能，

cues.en: and today we'd already be seeing the drastic cuts in carbon dioxide
cues.zh: 而今天我们早就看到了

cues.en: that are planned for 2040.
cues.zh: 原本计划到 2040 年才实现的二氧化碳大幅减排。

cues.en: And it would be America,
cues.zh: 那样领先的就会是美国，

cues.en: not China, with the technological lead selling these products to the rest of the world.
cues.zh: 而不是由中国凭借技术优势将这些产品卖向全世界。

cues.en: But when Ronald Reagan came to office, the White House solar water heater was taken down.
cues.zh: 但当 Ronald Reagan 上台后，白宫的太阳能热水器就被拆除了。

cues.en: Where is it now?
cues.zh: 它现在在哪儿呢？

cues.en: Well, Carter's words were prophetic.
cues.zh: Carter 的话真是一语成谶。

cues.en: A museum piece.
cues.zh: 一件博物馆展品。

cues.en: An example of a road
cues.zh: 一条未选

cues.en: not taken. To be precise, it's in Huangming's
cues.zh: 之路的写照。确切地说，它现在在 Huangming 的

cues.en: solar museum
cues.zh: 太阳能博物馆，

cues.en: in Solar Valley.
cues.zh: 位于 Solar Valley。

cues.en: An example of the road America didn't take, and still won't take,
cues.zh: 它是美国未曾涉足、且仍不愿涉足的道路的见证，

cues.en: but along which China is more than happy to lead the way.
cues.zh: 但中国却非常乐意在这条路上引领前行。
